# AxisVela Open

> A public map of independent, open-source and open-surface projects for
> governed autonomy: agents, workflows, robots, digital twins, and the systems
> that connect them.

This file is a compact index for AI-assisted discovery. The human entry point is
https://github.com/axisvela/axisvela-open.

## Start

- [Start here](https://github.com/axisvela/axisvela-open/blob/main/docs/start-here.md)
- [Project index](https://github.com/axisvela/axisvela-open/blob/main/docs/projects/index.md)
- [Ecosystem map](https://github.com/axisvela/axisvela-open/blob/main/docs/ecosystem-map.md)
- [Concepts](https://github.com/axisvela/axisvela-open/blob/main/docs/concepts/index.md)
- [Relationships](https://github.com/axisvela/axisvela-open/blob/main/docs/reference/relationships.md)
- [Machine-readable index](https://github.com/axisvela/axisvela-open/blob/main/projects.yaml)

## Foundation

- [PRAXO-CORE](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core): MIT Go agent framework; loop, primitives, adapters, policy, sandbox, plugins.
- [Harmovela](https://github.com/axisvela/harmovela): open coordination protocol for events, tasks, state, delegation, recovery, governance.
- [COORDIVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/coordivela-open): development coordination control plane for humans and agents.

## Runtime and cognition

- [PRAXOVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/praxovela-open): deny-by-default local agent runtime with effect ledger and replayable traces.
- [Mnemovela](https://github.com/axisvela/mnemovela-open): typed, branchable agent memory with hybrid retrieval and governed forgetting.
- [Noetivela](https://github.com/axisvela/noetivela-open): inference fabric with model catalog, inference contracts, and governed routing.

## Work and capabilities

- [ORCHADYN](https://github.com/axisvela/orchadyn-open): planning compiler for verified, revisable plans.
- [MODUREGIS](https://github.com/axisvela/moduregis-open): capability control plane for publishing, discovery, authorization, invocation, audit.
- [RHEOVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/rheovela-open): durable, event-sourced workflow platform for governed capability plans.

## Trust and knowledge

- [EIDOVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/eidovela-open): agent identity provider with workload attestation and PoP tokens.
- [NOMIVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/NOMIVELA-open): agent registry and namespace authority.
- [AEGIVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/aegivela-open): authorization, delegation, approvals, revocation, and security evidence.
- [GNOSIVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/gnosivela-open): semantic and knowledge fabric with scoped grounding views.
- [ONTOVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/ontovela-open): evidence-bearing bitemporal world model and digital twin.

## Boundary and assurance

- [LIMENORA](https://github.com/axisvela/limenora-open): governed integration gateway for APIs, MCP, events, and webhooks.
- [TEKMOVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/tekmovela-open): verification contracts, reproducible tests, and release gates.
- [PEIRAVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/peiravela-open): possible-world simulation and experiment control plane.
- [SYNDOVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/SYNDOVELA-open): agent-skill composition and supply-chain governance.

## Human and physical

- [SYMBIVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/symbivela-open): human-agent collaboration workspace for approvals, exceptions, and intervention.
- [KINETOVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/kinetovela-open): physical-autonomy control plane for robot fleets.

## Design and program

- [TAXOVELA](https://github.com/axisvela/TAXOVELA): AI-native architecture design and validation skills + CLI.
- [Enterprise Autonomy](https://github.com/axisvela/enterprise-autonomy): public introduction, reference stacks, and runnable examples.
- [PAMP](https://github.com/axisvela/AXISRobo-PAMP): enterprise architecture management platform.

## Notes

- An `*-open` repository is often an open integration surface, not the entire runtime.
- Licenses vary. The `LICENSE` in each repository is authoritative.
- AxisVela is an independent project family, not a company.
